title: Auditing Shapley attribution and measurement coverage in literature-derived alloy portfolios: data and reproducible code
description: Data and source code for the empirical portfolio audit, bounded monotone completion analysis, separately reported complete-design simulation generators, and paired measurement-coverage extension. GitHub tracks data and reproducible code; generated results are local outputs. Original experimental sources are identified in the data.
notes: Supported by TÜBİTAK Career Development Program (3501), Project No. 125F375. MIT applies to original project software; source-specific terms apply to literature-derived data.
